title: Arbucep
extract:
Arbucep is  Nokko's Signature Arch-gun. This mushroom-shaped launcher simultaneously fires six homing rockets, one from each of the secondary elements ( Blast,  Corrosive,  Gas,  Magnetic,  Radiation, and  Viral). Shooting at Nokko's  Stinkbrain or  Brightbonnet causes them to release their pulses and become empowered.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Blast,  Corrosive,  Gas,  Magnetic,  Radiation, and  Viral damage.
Multishot increases weapon damage instead of creating additional projectiles.
Damage bonus is multiplicative to other sources of damage.

Acquisition
Arbucep's main and component blueprints are acquired from Deepmines Bounties as an uncommon and rare drop. Access requires completion of The New War.
Alternatively Arbucep's blueprints can be purchased from Nightcap in Fortuna with  Fergolyte from Deepmines Bounties. Each component blueprint requires 150 and the main blueprint requires 220, totaling 670 Fergolytes for the whole set. Players must be at Rank 3 - Seeker with Nightcap in order to purchase.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

visit here.

Crafting

Notes
Unlike other Signature Weapons which require the Warframe to be carrying the weapon, the signature effect of empowering Nokko's mushrooms can be triggered by any Warframe wielding Arbucep.

Trivia
The Arbucep appears to be a fungal growth over an existing, presumably corpus-made, heavy weapon.
